description: A Java class named ContactOperations that provides helper methods for creating, updating, and managing contact data through Android's Contacts ContentProvider. It supports operations like adding names, emails, phones, avatars, and other contact details, as well as batch operations for contact management.

classes.name: ContactOperations
classes.description: Helper class for storing data in the platform content providers, supporting creation and update of contact entries with batch operations.

methods.name: createNewContact
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ContactOperations for adding a new contact.

methods.name: updateExistingContact
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ContactOperations for updating an existing contact.

methods.name: addName
methods.description: Adds a name to the contact, either as a full name or separated first and last names.

methods.name: addEmail
methods.description: Adds an email address to the contact.

methods.name: addPhone
methods.description: Adds a phone number with specified type to the contact.

methods.name: addGroupMembership
methods.description: Associates the contact with a group by group ID.

methods.name: addAvatar
methods.description: Downloads avatar from URL and adds it to the contact’s profile.

methods.name: addProfileAction
methods.description: Adds a profile action related to a user ID.

methods.name: updateServerId
methods.description: Updates the contact with a server ID.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates the email address of the contact.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the contact’s name fields.

methods.name: updateDirtyFlag
methods.description: Flags the contact as dirty or clean for sync purposes.

methods.name: updatePhone
methods.description: Updates the contact’s phone number.

methods.name: updateAvatar
methods.description: Updates the contact’s avatar image.

methods.name: updateProfileAction
methods.description: Updates the profile action data for the contact.

methods.name: addInsertOp
methods.description: Adds an insert operation to the batch, inserting contact data.

methods.name: addUpdateOp
methods.description: Adds an update operation to the batch.

methods.name: newInsertCpo
methods.description: Creates a new insert ContentProviderOperation builder with sync adapter parameters.

methods.name: newUpdateCpo
methods.description: Creates a new update ContentProviderOperation builder with sync adapter parameters.

methods.name: newDeleteCpo
methods.description: Creates a new delete ContentProviderOperation builder with sync adapter parameters.

methods.name: addCallerIsSyncAdapterParameter
methods.description: Adds a query parameter to indicate sync adapter call for permission purposes.
